summary: ATIF Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended January 31, 2026 and 2025, along with management's discussion and analysis. The filing contains no special-situation event—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. It is a routine interim financial report by a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into an existing F-3 registration statement. The financials show cash of $1.5M, total assets $40.4M, equity $38.7M, and a net loss of $280k for the period. No deal terms are present.
